publisher: County of San Bernardino Land Use Services Department
notes: County land use zoning districts (2024 May layer), unincorporated county. TEXT1 is the zoning code (e.g. RL-5, 7M-RM); TEXT2 the alternate code. The filter drops LU/-prefixed general-plan land use categories (CH, CR and similar), which are not zoning districts; so areas labelled only LU/ (e.g. parts of the Ludlow desert) have no zoning polygon in this layer. Incorporated cities zone their own land and are not in this layer.
